title: Clinker Oven
pages: Craft the Clinker Oven from four iron ingots, two blackstone blocks, two pistons, a hopper and a Kiln. Rows: iron/blackstone/iron; piston/Kiln/piston; iron/hopper/iron. Clinker one bricks block into a Clinker Brick; it replaces the upper-right plain bricks block in the Ember Dryer craft. Material update: crafting slot 1 (row-major 3x3) now requires a tungsten ingot via forge:ingots/tungsten; all existing progression gates remain required.

The oven heat-shatters 19 stone and deepslate variants into Gravel for screening, and turns a bricks block into the Clinker Brick required for the Ember Dryer. It vitrifies the clay bond of a Green Grinding Wheel into the Vitrified Grinding Wheel that the Lens Grinder craft needs (240 ticks, 14 FE/t). It fires a Green Porcelain Insulator (shapeless: four clay balls, one Screened Silica and one diorite as the feldspar flux; makes two) into the white Porcelain Insulator the Arc Press craft needs (220 ticks, 13 FE/t); hoppers can feed green insulators in and pull fired ones out like any other clinkering job. It also cures a Filled Dry-Lube Bearing into the Cured Dry-Lube Bearing the Coal Forge craft needs (200 ticks, 12 FE/t). It also runs 16 distinct furnace-equivalent heat jobs: sand to glass, raw iron to an ingot, clay balls to bricks, netherrack to nether bricks, cactus or sea pickles to dyes, chorus fruit to popped fruit, potatoes to baked potatoes, kelp to dried kelp, and beef, pork, chicken, mutton, rabbit, cod and salmon to cooked food. Cooking, dye, chorus, kelp, netherrack and raw-iron jobs take four inputs for five outputs; glass, bricks and baked potatoes stay one-to-one. Each uses 120 ticks and 8 FE/t. Stone jobs use 10-28 FE/t; the Clinker Brick takes 120 ticks. It fires a Green Assay Crucible into the Clay-Graphite Assay Crucible the Assay Cupel Hearth craft needs (220 ticks, 14 FE/t); hoppers can feed and empty it. It also brazes a Prepared Braze Joint into a Brazed Joint (200 ticks, 12 FE/t), required for the Induction Coiler contact seam. Feed prepared joints through the input port and extract finished joints from the output port.

Top and horizontal faces import items; the bottom exports. Set any face Off, In or Out from the menu. Hoppers and Forge item handlers can automate input and output. The two slots, energy, progress and side settings persist on save/load; work pauses when the output is full.

Datapacks add clinkering recipes under data/<namespace>/recipes with type arcana_industry:clinkering, ingredient (item or tag), count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. Higher priority wins, then ascending recipe ID. JEI shows inputs, outputs, time, FE and the Clinker Oven catalyst; JEI is optional.

For t6 thermal insulation, feed two magma blocks into the powered Clinker Oven. Its 220-tick, 14 FE/t mineral-fibre treatment yields one Mineral Fibre Lagging. Insert from top or an input side, supply FE, and extract the finished mat from bottom or an output side. JEI lists the clinkering recipe; use the lagging in the top middle of the Heat Exchanger craft.
